notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2024. Source is the UBS Group AG Annual Report 2024 as filed on Form 20-F, downloaded from the SEC filings page of ubs.com (www.sec.gov not contacted). Dividends are cross-checked against SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001610520). UBS reports in USD; values in USD bn (geography is reported only to one decimal in USD bn). LEADER: Sergio Ermotti (Group CEO since 2023, also 2011-2020) held 1,732,094 vested shares plus 1,023,411 unvested/at-risk shares (2,755,505 in total, including related parties) at 31 December 2024; shares records the vested figure. The table's 'potentially conferred voting rights' column shows 0.215%, which counts unvested shares and is a voting-rights measure, so it is not used as pctEconomic. No economic percentage is disclosed, so pctEconomic is null. HOLDERS: FMIA notifications measure % of 'the voting rights associated with the total share capital ... at the time of the respective disclosure notification'; with one share class this is equivalent to share of capital. Dates are the notification dates (BlackRock's is from 30 November 2023). Norges Bank fell to 4.90% on 22 January 2025. DTC (Cede & Co.) is registered with 6.48% but is a clearing nominee, not a beneficial owner. BUYBACKS: 1.00 = shares bought under the 2024 share repurchase program (acquisition cost USD 1,000m, about 33m shares, all intended for cancellation); no shares were bought under the concluded 2022 program in 2024. Excluded: USD 1,981m of shares bought by Group Treasury to hedge employee share-based compensation, and Investment Bank market-making. The cash-flow line 'Net movements in treasury shares and own equity derivative activity' (USD 2,923m outflow) is net and mixes these with market-making and derivatives, so it is not used. Note this differs from records where the only purchases were plan-hedging purchases (see report). DIVIDENDS: USD 2,256m distributions paid on UBS shares (USD 0.70 per share; 50% paid out of retained earnings and the balance out of the capital contribution reserve). STOCK COMP: USD 1,118m total personnel expense for share-based equity-settled compensation excluding social security (Note 27 footnote 4). The same footnote gives USD 1,128m of share-based compensation inside variable compensation (the XBRL ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees fact) plus USD 134m in other categories; the equity-settled total is used.
